t: Lathe: Score all 17 spokes with shift direction, urgency, and investment profiles
description: Lathe spoke_lathe.json has 'spokes: {}' — zero spokes scored. This blocks the entire Compass dashboard (which shows '0 spokes'). Create tools/lathe_score.py that reads hub-registry.json + gardener scan_state and populates spoke_lathe.json with the pre-classified spoke data below.

spoke_classifications._note: Pre-classified by Opus. Sonnet: use these values directly, do not re-evaluate.

wheelwright-hub.reason: Hub orchestration, advisor system lives here

perceive: Read hub-registry.json for all 17 spokes. Read gardener scan_state.json for last_tended and health. Read each spoke's WAI-State.json for session_count and last_closeout. Understand each spoke's purpose from its foundation identity.
execute: Create tools/lathe_score.py that: (1) reads hub-registry.json, (2) reads gardener scan_state.json, (3) for each spoke: reads WAI-State.json _project_foundation.identity, (4) assigns shift_direction based on activity pattern (active dev = growth, stable = maintain, dormant = sunset/research), (5) assigns urgency 1-5 based on session recency and open lug count, (6) writes investment_profile with time_hours and attention_minutes estimates, (7) defines inter_relation groups, (8) writes populated spoke_lathe.json. Run the script to populate initial data.
verify: spoke_lathe.json has 17 entries in spokes dict. Each entry has shift_direction, urgency, investment_profile. Script runs without error: python3 tools/lathe_score.py
acceptance_criteria: Each spoke has shift_direction from valid set (maintain/growth/revenue/research/sunset)
Each spoke has urgency 1-5 and investment_profile
Inter-relation groups defined for related spokes
tools/lathe_score.py runs idempotently and can be re-run by gardener
